literal: Wealth which is called unfailing lamp darkness will destroy intended to the land having gone.
translation: The unfailing lamp called wealth will travel to whatever land one intends and dispel the darkness there.
modern: பொருள் என்று சொல்லப்படும் அணையாத விளக்கு, ஒருவர் நினைத்த நாட்டிற்குச் சென்று அங்குள்ள இருளைப் போக்கும்.
explanation: The couplet metaphorically describes wealth as an unfailing lamp. Unlike a physical lamp that stays in one place and can be extinguished, the lamp of wealth can travel to any land its owner desires. Once there, it dispels the darkness of poverty, helplessness, or enmity. The word 'பொய்யா' (unfailing) emphasizes that wealth is a reliable tool that consistently achieves the intended results across borders.
